title: Built A Playable 3D Platformer In 72 Hours With UE 5.8 MCP And 3D AI Generation
author: Certain_Friendship16

comments.author: Fstr21
comments.body: Was not aware ue had an mcp. How was the experience using it ?

replies.author: Certain_Friendship16
replies.body: yeah, it’s still pretty new and experimental, but honestly the experience was surprisingly good. It can understand the scene, help organize assets, create, edit Blueprints, and speed up a lot of repetitive UE work. Still needs supervision, but for prototyping it saves a crazy amount of time
